newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmen '97 oil/condensate output seen at 5.9mln T.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen '97 oil/condensate output seen at 5.9mln T.

text.p: Turkmen output of oil and gas condensates is likely to rise to 5.9 million tonnes in 1997, the official Turkmen-Press news agency said on Monday.
The agency quoted official figures as saying the former Soviet republic of Turkmenistan produced about 5.5 million tonnes of oil and gas condensates in 1996 after 3.5 million tonnes in 1995.

About 500,000 tonnes of increased production was expected from the republic's Yuzhny Kamyshlydzha oil field where, the agency said, where new production technology is to be installed by Germany's Siemens AG.
Earlier this year, Turkmen President Saparmurad Niyazov said the country aimed to raise oil production to 10 million tonnes by 2000.
